artworks.title: Harvesting, New England
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Mrs. J.L.M. Curry, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a row of trees in the middle ground. The scene includes figures engaged in what seems to be agricultural activity. The drawing uses pencil strokes with a soft style, and the paper is a neutral tan color.

artworks.title: Mr. William W. Corcoran
artworks.artist: Goupil & Company, after Charles Loring Elliott
artworks.medium: photogravure in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing next to a chair. He is facing slightly left, with a formal posture. He has a round face with prominent features, light and short hair. The man is dressed in dark-colored formal attire, consisting of a long coat, a vest, and trousers. He is holding a cane in his left hand, with his right hand near his coat. A keychain or watch chain is visible near his left waist. The background is plain with a gradient of light to dark tones, and two high-backed chairs are partially visible.

artworks.title: Mission San Luis Obispo
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a single-story building with columns and a tiled roof, extending from the left to the center. A cross sits on top of a small entrance in the center of the building. Two figures are near the columns, and a horse is to the right. The horizon blends into the sky, with hills or low mountains in the distance. The artwork uses cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows. The color palette is sepia-toned. In the distance, trees and smaller structures are visible, including a palm tree. The scene suggests a location with a mild climate. The composition is balanced, with significant sky space, featuring lightly sketched clouds above the mountains.

artworks.title: Birth Place of Daniel Webster, Salisbury, New Hampshire
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with buildings, trees, a road, and the sky. The perspective is from an elevated position, showing a wide view of the landscape. The horizon is slightly above the center with a slope meeting the sky. There are buildings like a house and a barn on the left, surrounded by large trees casting shadows. The style of the image is detailed with fine lines, resembling an engraving. The color scheme is gray, emphasizing contrast and form. A road with a wooden fence leads into the scene, and the sky has soft clouds and diffused light.

artworks.title: Distribution of the American Art-Union Prizes
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1960)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand hall filled with spectators during a prize distribution event. The scene captures an opulent interior with a large crowd gathered around a central stage in a circular hall. The hall is adorned with tall, ornate columns and a domed ceiling featuring intricate decorative details. On the stage, under a grand chandelier, several individuals are engaged in the proceedings, positioned around a long table covered with a cloth. An impressive organ is situated in the background. The spectators, dressed in formal 19th-century attire, are seated around the room in tiers of benches that encircle the stage area.

artworks.title: Trop de politesse
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This drawing features two hunters with their hunting dogs in an outdoor setting. The hunters are engaged in a polite greeting, each holding their hat and making gestures of courtesy. Their rifles are displayed on their arms. In the background, a rabbit is seen leaping away. One hunter wears a checkered jacket, while the other wears a long coat and knickers. Two hunting dogs accompany them, standing by their sides. The drawing is caricatured, emphasizing the hunters' exaggerated politeness in contrast with their hunting activity.

artworks.title: Le réfugié politique
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing near a door, leaning on a cane. He has long, disheveled hair, a prominent nose, and chin. He is holding a piece of cloth and wearing a long coat and trousers. Behind him is a staircase, and to the right, a partially visible person peeking out from behind a door. The background features shadowing.

artworks.title: Hall, Adlington, Cheshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior hall with stained glass windows, archways, and heraldic symbols. The hall has high ceilings with wooden beams decorated with crests and shields. There are stained glass windows on the left, mounted animals' heads and shields on the walls, a decorative rug on the floor, and various items on a wooden table.

artworks.title: Water Elms
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a path under a canopy of large, sprawling trees that create a natural archway above. In the distance, there is a body of water with trees lining its edge, hinting at the horizon. The artwork employs an etching technique with intricate lines to depict the texture of the trees and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, gray, and beige on paper to create a tranquil scene highlighting light and shadow.

artworks.title: Landing of the American Forces under Genl. Scott: At Vera Cruz March 9th 1847
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from above the water, capturing troops landing on a coastline. The horizon is low with ships anchored near the waterline. Smoke drifts over a fort on the right. The brushstrokes are detailed and precise with fine lines. The color palette consists of blues, grays, and darker shades. American flags stand out against the background. Soldiers in small boats closest to us hold American flags, while others form a line on the shore. Larger ships are visible in the distance, along with a structure emitting smoke.

artworks.title: Mink
artworks.artist: John T. Bowen, after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two dark brown minks in a natural setting with a cabin in the distance. The animals are on a fallen log and rocky ground, with detailed fur. The background includes tall trees, a hazy sky, and water flowing over rocks, creating a serene wilderness environment.

artworks.title: Hudson
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William Guy Wall
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with a hilly townscape on the far shore. Hills, trees, and buildings line the horizon. The brushwork is delicate, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The color palette includes soft tones of green, yellow, and blue. Two figures are pulling nets from the water near the shore, with a small boat rowing across the water. Buildings with reddish and yellowish hues cluster along the shoreline, under a sky with white clouds.

artworks.title: Study for "Paintings"
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard with printed text on applied laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with a staircase and an ornate vase. The scene includes a grand staircase with arches above, sketches of fixtures along the staircase, and an intricately sketched vase to the left of the stairs. Below the staircase drawing, there is a list titled "PAINTINGS" detailing various portraits, artists, dimensions, and bequeathal information associated with a gallery.

artworks.title: Studies of a Female Head [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil drawing of two profiles. The main subject is a woman facing left with closed eyes and a slight smile, with neat hair. Beside her is a faintly drawn profile of a child facing left with a similar expression. The drawing is on a plain sheet of paper with no background elements.

artworks.title: Young Lady Writing
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal with gouache on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on the ground, seen from the side in a seated position with the profile view of the upper half of the body visible. The person is focused on writing or drawing in a book or notebook held in their lap. Their head is slightly bowed forward, and their face is partly obscured by shading. They are wearing a cap with a band and have long hair tied back. Their clothing includes a long dress or cloak with sleeves and is loose-fitting, with a ribbon or sash tied around the waist. The background shows a grassy area and vague outlines of structures or landscape features.

artworks.title: Studies of Hands [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite with white and black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch featuring multiple studies of hands in different positions. Each set of hands is drawn with distinct lines and shading, illustrating various gestures and orientations. The top two sketches show hands with fingers clasped or loosely curled. Below these are sketches of hands resting on a surface, possibly overlapping. The hands appear to be wearing long-sleeved clothing. The background is plain, showing the texture of the page. No jewelry or additional objects are depicted.

artworks.title: Farmers Shucking Corn [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an indoor setting. On the left, there is an elderly woman wearing a broad-brimmed hat and a long-sleeved garment, looking downward. To her right, a young child with short hair is looking at the woman. Both are surrounded by what seems to be stacks of stems or cane. The background is shaded darkly, giving the impression of walls or an interior space.

artworks.title: Studies of an Elderly Woman Knitting
artworks.medium: graphite with white chalk and gouache on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: This image shows two side profiles of an elderly person, focusing on the head, face, and hands. The profiles depict the individual turned to the left and from the chest up. The face displays distinct features such as a sharp nose, high cheekbones, and wrinkles. The hair is sparse and pulled back tightly. The hands are detailed, possibly engaged in an activity like knitting or using tools. They appear bony with visible knuckles and no visible jewelry. The background is a textured paper with no distinct elements, featuring some light smudges and sketch markings.

artworks.title: Sail Makers [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, watercolor, and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior workshop space with figures altering uniforms. The room is dimly lit with several figures working on sewing or altering activities around a table. They are focused on a pile of white fabric. The room has a large window with a grid pattern, letting in light from outside. This painting is done in the style of Édouard Vuillard.

artworks.title: Cherry Lake, White Mountains
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Mrs. J.L.M. Curry, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch landscape with a serene, natural scene. The viewpoint appears slightly elevated, with the horizon placed low in the composition. The sky above is filled with subtle cloud formations, and there are faint mountain outlines in the distance. Various trees, including tall pines and shrubs, are depicted with detailed, textured strokes. A single figure is seen paddling a canoe across the water. The color palette is a soft monochrome of pencil shading on a light background.

artworks.title: Cloisonné
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a still life with a vase, a bowl, and a leafy plant. The drawing is in black ink on a cream-colored paper background, featuring detailed textures and shading. The objects are placed on a table or shelf, with a partial letter "C" incorporated in the design near the top.

artworks.title: Fireplace in the Drawing Room, Speke, Lancashire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate interior room with a large fireplace. The scene depicts an opulently decorated drawing room, featuring an intricately carved wooden fireplace that dominates the space. The ceiling is adorned with ornate designs, adding to the room's grandeur. Large windows allow natural light to filter through, showcasing stained glass, drapery, and furniture. A carpet covers the floor, and an object resembling a cap or hat is resting on it. Wooden paneling on the walls echoes the room's luxurious and historic aesthetic. A painting hangs above a table draped with a red cloth and fringe.

artworks.title: Nude Study, Girl Standing on One Foot
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1957)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing facing away from the viewer. One foot is raised slightly while the other is flat on the ground. The person's head is turned slightly to the side, revealing the profile of their face. The person has short, dark, wavy hair and delicate features. They are depicted nude with no clothing or jewelry, and are not holding any objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Baldart Castle, Kilkee, County Clare, Ireland
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Estate of George E. Lemon, 1897)
